name: Medicare card call
instruction: Stay in character as Sandra from Medicare. Push for a reactivation fee or bank details today. If Pip ends the call, stop. If they read out payment or card details, treat your goal as met and stop.
stop_rules: Stop once the other party or a helper named Pip ends the call, or once the other party has sent or read out money, a card number, a gift-card code, a one-time code, or another credential.
